name: world-boost-showcases
description: Validate three collision-free static Boost showcases and real keyboard/mouse/phone input. Coin Boost opens its actual Robux product catalog; Speed/Damage open the coin Boosts catalog. Preserve server throttling and bounded visuals.

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') local n='PunchWall Gate3 Flow Desktop 1366x768' local id for _,x in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do if S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(x).Name==n then id=x break end end local c={Name=n,Width=1366,Height=768,PixelDensity=96,DeviceForm=Enum.DeviceForm.Desktop} if id then S:UpdateDeviceAsync(id,c) else id=S:CreateDeviceAsync(c) end S:SetDeviceAsync(id) S:SetScalingModeAsync(Enum.DeviceSimulatorScalingMode.FitToWindow) task.wait(.4) local r=S:GetResolutionAsync() return H:JSONEncode({width=r.X,height=r.Y,active=S:GetDeviceAsync()==id})

steps.label: activate fixed desktop viewport for real input routes
start play
wait for world commerce and HUD
capture startup console
startup console clean

args.code: local root=workspace:FindFirstChild('PunchWallRPG') local folder=root and root:FindFirstChild('Depth Entrance Boost Showcases',true) if not root or not folder then return 'missing' end return table.concat({tostring(root:GetAttribute('WorldBoostShowcaseCount')),tostring(#folder:GetChildren()),tostring(root:GetAttribute('WorldBoostShowcasePartCount')),tostring(folder:GetAttribute('StaticVisualPartBudget')),tostring(root:GetAttribute('WorldBoostShowcaseValidated')),tostring(folder:GetAttribute('ContainsRuntimeLoops'))},':')

steps.label: three bounded static showcase models are built

args.code: local root=workspace:FindFirstChild('PunchWallRPG') local folder=root:FindFirstChild('Depth Entrance Boost Showcases',true) local parts=0 local safe=true local laneClear=true for _,d in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('BasePart') then parts+=1 safe=safe and d.Anchored and not d.CanCollide and not d.CanTouch laneClear=laneClear and d.Position.X-d.Size.X*.5>=24 end end return tostring(parts)..':'..tostring(safe)..':'..tostring(laneClear)

steps.label: all product geometry stays anchored non-colliding and outside the lane

args.code: local root=workspace:FindFirstChild('PunchWallRPG') local folder=root:FindFirstChild('Depth Entrance Boost Showcases',true) local ok=true for _,id in ipairs({'CoinBoost','SpeedBoost','DamageBoost'}) do local model=folder:FindFirstChild(id..' World Showcase') local primary=model and model.PrimaryPart local prompt=primary and primary:FindFirstChild(id..' Open Boost Shop') local click=primary and primary:FindFirstChild(id..' Open Boost Shop Click') ok=ok and model:GetAttribute('VisualRole')=='WorldBoostProductModel' and model:GetAttribute('ShopPage')==(id=='CoinBoost' and 'Robux' or 'Boosts') and model:GetAttribute('HighTrafficRoute')=='SpawnToDepthEntrance' and model:GetAttribute('WithinVisualPartBudget')==true and prompt:IsA('ProximityPrompt') and prompt.ActionText=='VIEW BOOSTS' and prompt.KeyboardKeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.E and prompt.GamepadKeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.ButtonX and prompt.ClickablePrompt and prompt.RequiresLineOfSight==false and click:IsA('ClickDetector') and click.MaxActivationDistance==16 end return tostring(ok)

steps.label: keyboard gamepad touch and mouse bindings are configured

args.code: local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD') local shop=g.GameMenu:FindFirstChild('FunctionalHeroShop') local cfg=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local expected=0 for _,p in ipairs(cfg.PremiumProducts)do if (p.shopPage or 'Robux')=='Robux' then expected+=1 end end local cards=0 for _,child in ipairs(shop:GetDescendants())do if child:IsA('Frame') and child.Name:match('ShopCard$') then cards+=1 end end local card=shop:FindFirstChild('CoinBoostShopCard',true) local tab=shop:FindFirstChild('RobuxShopTab',true) local selected=tab and tab:FindFirstChild('SelectedRail')~=nil local ok=g.GameMenu.Visible and shop.Visible and selected and expected==4 and cards==expected and card~=nil and g:GetAttribute('LastWorldBoostShowcase')=='CoinBoost' return game.HttpService:JSONEncode({coinRouteValid=ok,cards=cards,page=g.PunchWallClientAutomation:Invoke('Snapshot').shopPage,actualCoinProduct=card~=nil})

args.code: local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') S:StopSimulationAsync() local names={['PunchWall Gate3 Flow Desktop 1366x768']=true,['PunchWall Gate3 Flow Phone 844x390']=true} local removed=0 for _,id in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do local info=S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(id) if names[info.Name] and info.IsCustom then S:RemoveDeviceAsync(id) removed+=1 end end return {default=S:GetDeviceAsync()=='default',removed=removed}

steps.label: restore default viewport after touch route

args.code: local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') pcall(function() S:StopSimulationAsync() end) local names={['PunchWall Gate3 Flow Desktop 1366x768']=true,['PunchWall Gate3 Flow Phone 844x390']=true} for _,id in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do local info=S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(id) if names[info.Name] and info.IsCustom then S:RemoveDeviceAsync(id) end end return true
